title: 010 三步唐门
content_zh:
雷无桀大惊：“是你！”
“他们果然还在这里。”一个白发之人落在了紫衣人身边。
“唐莲和那雷家的小子都中了我一掌，没三个时辰运功疗伤是走不了的。”紫衣人目光在房内扫了一圈，最终落在了躺在长椅上的无心，“是他？”
白发人此时也注意到了无心，他一皱眉，喝道：“带走！”话一说完，紫衣人已经一跃而起，冲着无心掠去。然而一个人比他更快，一个闪身便挡在了无心的面前，一拳向紫衣人击去。正是无禅！
“不自量力。”紫衣人冷笑一声，也一掌打了过去。
“小心他的掌力！”雷无桀急忙提醒，他与紫衣人对过招，明白他掌力的可怕，可拳掌相交之后，无禅依旧稳稳地站在那里，紫衣人却急退了三步。
“这是金刚伏魔神通？”白发人微微一皱眉，望向无禅，只见他自外而内不带半分邪气，面目刚猛犹如金刚，“怕是已有八重功力。”
“佛家第一外门武学？”紫衣人虽然被一拳打得急退，但却依然神色悠然，“倒是低估了这个和尚。”
“小心点。”白发人低声提醒。
紫衣人一笑：“九龙寺大觉和尚我倒也见过几次，你是大觉的弟子？”
“在大觉住持座下学习武艺已有十二年，然而只传武学，未悟佛道，不敢称师。”无禅拳重重一挥，“请施主赐教。”
“好。”紫衣人掏出怀中折扇，悠然地扇了扇，“赐教就算了，把命留下吧。”
“紫衣，不要恋战。把人先带走。”白发人手持玉剑，冷冷地望着躺在长椅上的无心。
“你就是心慈手软，杀光了这些人不是更好，不然就算你抢了人，他们还不是要追上来。”紫衣人瞥了雷无桀一眼，“小子，刚刚念在雷轰的份上没有杀你。可你们不自量力，却不要怪本侯了。”
“你！”雷无桀想要运气，可胸口却一阵血气上涌，几乎昏倒过去。
“没用的。”萧瑟摇头，“你中了他的掌，若没有人为你运功疗伤，怕是十天之内都运不得真气了。”
“你小子倒是见多识广，你是……”紫衣人好奇地望着萧瑟，手中折扇轻挥。
“紫衣！别多话了！”白发人怒吼一声，身形一闪，已掠过了众人，冲着无心而去。他的一声怒吼之下，唐莲和雷无桀都不由地吐出一口鲜血，跌倒在地，萧瑟和天女蕊则下意识地捂住了耳朵，只有一个人丝毫没有受到影响——无禅！他在白发的起身的那一瞬间也立刻动了！
“挡住他。”白发人目光凛冽，去势未减。
紫衣人手中折扇猛地一挥，向无禅袭去。无禅不敢恋战，运起金刚伏魔神通，转瞬间已三拳挥去。但紫衣人手中的纸扇与无禅的拳相交，却未有半分退让之势。刚才无禅一拳将紫衣人击退三步，心中对此人的功力已有了几分了解，可此时三拳挥去，却感觉拳力如泥牛入海，不由心中大惊。紫衣人冷笑道：“便还给你吧。”他折扇猛地撑开，无禅感觉一股内力如排山倒海般袭来，无法控制地往后猛退了三步。

紫衣人刚刚退了三步，便还了无禅三步！
而另一边，白发人早已站在了无心面前，他望着无心的眉眼，低声说道：“像，实在太像了。”他伸出手去，正欲搭在无心的肩膀上，却忽然缩回了手，他看到一根极细极小的针从面前划过，针上泛着微微的紫色，显然已淬了剧毒。
“龙须针。”白发人微微锁眉，扭头看向躺在地上的唐莲，“没想到你受了那么重的伤，还能有这样的手法。唐门的这一代中，你能排进前三？”
唐莲没有回答他，只是冷笑：“你有没有听过一句话。”
“哦？什么话？”白发人微微含笑，可手中却紧紧握住了玉剑，身上的长袍无风自舞，显然已运起了真气，随时准备一剑刺出。
“三步唐门，一步阎王。你，离我太近了！”唐莲猛地一跃而起，一口鲜血冲着白发人吐出。唐门，号称暗器之宗，毒绝天下，如果沾上那一滴血，会否把命丢掉？白发人不敢赌，所以他急退，他明白唐门之人将暗器之术练至极致的时候，自己本身也就成了一件暗器！
他身形极快，已躲过了那一口鲜血，但那鲜血之中，却又有一件事物飞了出来，那是一片小小的叶子，却染了血红的颜色。
“霜叶红！”白发人大惊，身体猛地一偏，那枚霜叶红从他的胸前擦过，几乎便击中了他。然而白发人也在这片刻失去了平衡，向一边倒去。
“蕊！”唐莲大呼。
几乎只在瞬间，天女蕊袖中寒光一现，两柄刀已经袭向了白发人的胸口。唐莲用了三道暗器终于为天女蕊完成了一个必杀之局。只要刀再往前一寸，便能结束了白发人的性命，但是……
“你的刀太慢了！”白发人右手将剑插在了地上，借势往前一冲，双手紧握，竟一把抓住了天女蕊的两柄短刀。短刀在瞬间崩裂成了几段，天女蕊急忙撤刀急退到唐莲身边，喘着重重的粗气。
“对不起，莲。我错失了机会。”天女蕊叹道。
“不是你的错，是他实在太强了。”唐莲摇头，“即便我没有受伤，我也不是他的对手。”
“唐门唐莲，你比我想象中要更强。”白发人将剑拔了出来，神色凛冽。
“这眼神，是真的要杀人了啊。”萧瑟叹了口气，在场的人只有他一个人还没有出手，可他偏偏又能以这样局外人的语气说话。
天女蕊扭头望了唐莲一眼，唐莲无奈地摇摇头，他几乎连站立起来的力量都没有了，更不用说再用暗器了。而另一边，无禅与紫衣人交手数次，却根本没有机会击退那一柄小小的纸扇，紫衣人显然已占尽了上风。
“还有我！”雷无桀终于按捺不住了，但是刚一运气便被萧瑟按住了肩膀，萧瑟难得用严肃的语气低声喝道：“如果你不想以后成为废人，就不要逞能。”
白发人持着剑一步一步往前走着，他刚刚低估了重伤的唐莲，这一次不会再犯同样的错误。“三步唐门，一步阎王”，一个人若真的走进唐门高手的三步之内，那么的确离死已经不远了，即便是一个将死的唐门高手，也同样不能大意。
唐莲却只是苦笑，然而就在这时，他忽然听到了一个陌生的声音，那是个少年的声音，带着几分笑意：“喂，你还能不能站起来啊。”
唐莲猛地一惊，扭头看身边的人，却都没有反应，似乎根本没有听到那个声音。

“喂，别看了，只有你能听到。如果你还有一点力气的话，就站到我的面前来。”
唐莲看向那个躺在长椅之上的无心和尚，却见他的嘴角带着几分若有若无的笑意，心中恍然大悟。
“还看什么？再看这个白头发的人就要把我带走啦！赶紧站到我的面前来。”
唐莲虽然心中不解，但也毫无办法，只能用尽所有力气站起了身，艰难地挪到了无心的面前，挡住了他。
“莲！”天女蕊急忙过去搀住他。
白发人止住了脚步，微微皱眉：“唐莲，我本不想杀你。你又何必逼我。”
唐莲正欲开口，却发现最后一口真气已泄，整个人便要跪倒在地，可忽然他感觉一个手掌抵在了他的后背上，一股强烈的真气从那手掌中传输到了他的身体里，他感觉到了一种说不出的温暖和煦，刚才疼痛的仿佛就要裂开的身体正以惊人的速度恢复着。
“你还有多少暗器？透骨钉？铁蒺藜？龙须针？你只有一击的机会，全部放出去！万树飞花的手法，不是每个唐门人都能掌握，但你是唐莲，一定没问题。”
“罢了。”白发人见唐莲执意不肯让开，叹了口气，手中长剑一挥，剑光闪烁。有的剑狠辣，有的剑轻灵，而白发人的剑……却很美。
像是大雪之夜，却长出一树梨花，而又瞬间崩落的美！那是绝美的一剑，也是必杀的一剑！
“就是现在！”那个声音对唐莲发出了最后的指令。
万树飞花！唐门外房第一暗器手法，即便是唐莲也没有完全掌握，但此时身逢绝境，唐莲竟然第一次将万树飞花用到了极致。他几乎将手上所有的暗器都丢了出去，它们像是一朵花一样在空中绽放了开来，然后冲着白发人以及紫衣人倾泻而下！
“怎么可能！”白发人和紫衣人同时发生了惊呼，他们手中玉剑、纸扇狂舞，一件件暗器摔落在了地上，却也将他们逼出了门外。
“你没有让我失望，不过这种程度还是杀不掉他们的。”那个声音依然带着笑意，但唐莲却感觉到背上的那只手收了回去，那股和煦的内力也逐渐在体内消散，整个人头一晕，昏倒了过去。
“莲！”天女蕊急忙去扶。
无心和尚却在此时站了起来，他睁开了眼睛，白袍轻舞，笑道：“见过这一场万树飞花，也不枉假睡一场了。”
“师弟！”无禅怒喝道。
“师兄好。”无心微微一挑眉毛，目光在场中急速地一扫，瞥到了站在角落里的萧瑟和雷无桀，微微一笑，一掠飞到了他们的身边，一手抓住一个人的肩膀，“这两位看着是个好人，小僧想去一个地方，不知二位施主可愿陪小僧一同前往啊。”
“什……什么地方？”雷无桀对这一场变故还没有反应过来。
“不想。”萧瑟倒是冷冰冰地答得干脆。

白发人和紫衣人已经重新踏进了房内，无心笑道：“口是心非。”说完把一手抓着一个，飞起来一脚踹开了窗户，落了下去。
content_en:
Lei Wujie was shocked: "It's you!"
"They are indeed still here." A man with white hair landed next to the man in purple.
"Both Tang Lian and the boy from the Lei family were hit by me, and they won't be able to leave within three hours of practicing martial arts to heal their injuries." The man in purple glanced around the room, and finally landed on Wu Xin lying on the bench, "Is it him?"
The white-haired man also noticed Wu Xin at this time. He frowned and shouted: "Take it away!" As soon as he finished speaking, the man in purple jumped up and rushed towards Wu Xin. However, there was a person who was faster than him. He stepped in front of Wu Xin and punched the man in purple. It’s Wu Zen!
"You don't overestimate your capabilities." The man in purple sneered and slapped him.
"Be careful with his palm power!" Lei Wujie reminded hurriedly. He had exchanged blows with the man in purple and understood how terrifying his palm power was. However, after the fists and palms met, Wu Chan still stood there steadily, but the man in purple took three steps back.
"Is this the magical power of King Kong to subdue demons?" The white-haired man frowned slightly and looked at Wu Chan. He saw that he had no evil spirit from the outside to the inside, and his face was as strong as King Kong. "I'm afraid he already has the eighth level of power."
"The number one external martial arts school in Buddhism?" Although the man in purple was knocked back sharply by the punch, he still looked calm, "I underestimated this monk."
"Be careful." The white-haired man reminded in a low voice.
The man in purple smiled: "I have met Monk Dajue of Jiulong Temple a few times. Are you a disciple of Dajue?"
"I have been studying martial arts under Abbot Dajue for twelve years. However, I only teach martial arts. I have not understood Buddhism and dare not call myself a master." Wu Chan waved his fist heavily and said, "Please give me some advice."
"Okay." The man in purple took out the folding fan from his arms and fanned it leisurely, "Forget it if you give me some advice, but keep your life."
"Zi Yi, don't be obsessed with fighting. Take the people away first." The white-haired man held a jade sword and looked coldly at Wu Xin lying on the bench.
"You are just merciful. Wouldn't it be better to kill all these people? Otherwise, even if you rob people, they still have to catch up." The man in purple glanced at Lei Wujie, "Boy, I just didn't kill you for Lei Hong's sake. But you guys are overestimating your own capabilities, so don't blame me."
"You!" Lei Wujie wanted luck, but blood surged in his chest and he almost fainted.
"It's useless." Xiao Se shook his head, "You were hit by his palm. If there is no one to heal your injuries, I'm afraid you won't be able to use Qi within ten days."
"You're a well-informed boy, you are..." The man in purple looked at Xiao Se curiously, waving the folding fan lightly in his hand.
"Zi Yi! Stop talking so much!" The white-haired man roared angrily, and in a flash, he had already passed by the crowd and headed towards Wu Xin. Under his roar, Tang Lian and Lei Wujie couldn't help but spit out a mouthful of blood and fell to the ground. Xiao Se and Tiannirui subconsciously covered their ears. Only one person was not affected at all - Wu Chan! The moment the white-haired boy stood up, he immediately moved!
"Block him." The white-haired man's gaze was stern, his power unabated.
The man in purple swung the folding fan in his hand and attacked Wu Chan. Wu Chan didn't dare to fight, so he used the magical power of King Kong to subdue demons, and in the blink of an eye he had punched away three times. But the paper fan in the purple man's hand intersected with Wu Chan's fist, but he didn't give in at all. Wu Chan had just punched the man in purple and knocked him back three steps. He already had some understanding of this man's skill. But now when he swung three punches, he felt that the power of the punch was like a mud cow entering the sea, and he couldn't help but be shocked. The man in purple sneered: "I'll give it back to you." He opened the folding fan suddenly, and Wu Chan felt an overwhelming amount of internal energy, and he took three steps back uncontrollably.
The man in purple had just taken three steps back, and then took three steps back to Wu Zen!
On the other side, the white-haired man had already stood in front of Wu Xin. He looked at Wu Xin's eyebrows and whispered, "It's so similar." He stretched out his hand and was about to put it on Wu Xin's shoulder, but suddenly retracted his hand. He saw an extremely fine needle passing in front of him, with a slight purple tint on it.The poison has been quenched.
"Dragon Beard Needle." The white-haired man frowned slightly and turned to look at Tang Lian who was lying on the ground. "I didn't expect you to be so seriously injured and still have such a technique. Among the Tang Sect's generation, can you rank among the top three?"
Tang Lian didn't answer him, just sneered: "Have you ever heard a sentence?"
"Oh? What are you talking about?" The white-haired man smiled slightly, but he held the jade sword tightly in his hand. The robe on his body was dancing in the wind. It was obvious that he had gathered his true energy and was ready to stab with the sword at any time.
"Three steps to the Tang Sect, one step to the King of Hell. You are too close to me!" Tang Lian suddenly jumped up and spat out a mouthful of blood at the white-haired man. Tang Sect, known as the sect of hidden weapons, is poisonous to the world. If it is stained with that drop of blood, will it cost you your life? The white-haired man didn't dare to gamble, so he retreated quickly. He understood that when the people of the Tang Sect practiced the art of hidden weapons to the extreme, he himself became a hidden weapon!
He was extremely fast and had already dodged the mouthful of blood, but something flew out from the blood. It was a small leaf, but it was stained with blood red color.
"Frost Leaf Red!" The white-haired man was shocked, and his body suddenly turned sideways. The frost leaf red ball passed by his chest and almost hit him. However, the white-haired man also lost his balance at this moment and fell to one side.
"Rui!" Tang Lian shouted.
Almost in an instant, a cold light appeared in Tiannu Rui's sleeves, and two knives had already struck the white-haired man's chest. Tang Lian used three hidden weapons to finally complete a killing blow for Tiannur Rui. As long as the knife is moved forward one inch, the life of the white-haired man can be ended, but...
"Your sword is too slow!" The white-haired man stuck the sword on the ground with his right hand, took advantage of the momentum and rushed forward, clenching his hands tightly, and actually grabbed Tiannu Rui's two daggers. The short sword broke into several pieces in an instant. Tiannurui hurriedly withdrew the sword and retreated to Tang Lian, breathing heavily.
"I'm sorry, Lian. I missed the opportunity." Tiannu Rui sighed.
"It's not your fault, it's just that he is too strong." Tang Lian shook his head, "Even if I am not injured, I am not his opponent."
"Tang Clan Tang Lian, you are stronger than I thought." The white-haired man pulled out the sword with a stern look on his face.
"This look is really killing someone." Xiao Se sighed. He was the only one present who had not yet taken action, but he could speak with such an outsider's tone.
Tiannu Rui turned her head and glanced at Tang Lian. Tang Lian shook his head helplessly. He almost didn't have the strength to stand up, let alone use a hidden weapon. On the other side, Wu Chan fought against the man in purple several times, but had no chance to repel the small paper fan. The man in purple obviously had the upper hand.
"And me!" Lei Wujie finally couldn't hold it anymore, but as soon as he got lucky, Xiao Se pressed his shoulder. Xiao Se whispered in a rare serious tone: "If you don't want to become a useless person in the future, don't show off."
The white-haired man walked forward step by step with his sword in hand. He had just underestimated the seriously injured Tang Lian and would not make the same mistake again this time. "Three steps to the Tang Sect, one step to the King of Hell." If a person really walks within three steps of a Tang Sect master, he is indeed not far from death. Even a dying Tang Sect master cannot be careless.
Tang Lian just smiled bitterly, but at this moment, he suddenly heard a strange voice. It was the voice of a young man, with a hint of smile: "Hey, can you still stand up?"
Tang Lian was suddenly startled and turned to look at the people around her, but none of them responded. It seemed that they had not heard the voice at all.
"Hey, stop looking, only you can hear me. If you still have a little strength, stand in front of me."
Tang Lian looked at the Wuxin monk lying on the bench, and saw a faint smile on his lips, and she suddenly realized.
"What are you still looking at? If you look at this white-haired man again, he will take me away! Stand in front of me quickly."Although Tang Lian was puzzled, she had no choice but to use all her strength to stand up and move in front of Wu Xin with difficulty, blocking him.
"Lian!" Tiannu Rui hurriedly went over to help him.
The white-haired man stopped and frowned slightly: "Tang Lian, I didn't want to kill you. Why do you have to force me."
Tang Lian was about to speak, but found that the last breath of his true energy had been released, and he was about to kneel on the ground. But suddenly he felt a palm on his back, and a strong true energy was transmitted from the palm to his body. He felt an indescribable warmth and warmth, and the body that seemed to be in pain just now was recovering at an alarming speed.
"How many hidden weapons do you have? Penetrating nails? Iron caltrops? Dragon beard needles? You only have one chance to strike, let them all go! Not everyone in the Tang Sect can master the technique of Thousand Trees Flying Flowers, but you are Tang Lian, so you will be fine."
"That's all." Seeing that Tang Lian refused to let go, the white-haired man sighed and waved his long sword in his hand, the sword light flashing. Some swords are fierce, some are light and agile, but the white-haired man's sword... is beautiful.
It's like a pear tree growing on a snowy night, and then suddenly falling apart! That is a beautiful sword, and it is also a sure-killing sword!
"Now!" The voice gave Tang Lian the final instruction.
Thousands of trees and flowers! Even Tang Lian had not fully mastered the number one hidden weapon technique of the Tang Sect's Outer House. But at this time, in a desperate situation, Tang Lian actually used Ten Thousand Trees and Flying Flowers to the extreme for the first time. He threw almost all the hidden weapons in his hand, and they bloomed in the air like a flower, and then poured down on the white-haired man and the purple-clothed man!
"How is that possible!" The white-haired man and the purple-clothed man exclaimed at the same time. The jade swords and paper fans in their hands danced wildly, and the hidden weapons fell to the ground, but they were also forced out of the door.
"You didn't disappoint me, but you still can't kill them at this level." The voice was still smiling, but Tang Lian felt the hand on his back retract, and the warm internal force gradually dissipated in the body. She felt dizzy and passed out.
"Lian!" Tiannu Rui hurriedly went to help her.
Monk Wuxin stood up at this moment, opened his eyes, his white robe danced lightly, and said with a smile: "After seeing thousands of trees and flowers flying like this, it's not a waste to sleep for a while."
"Junior brother!" Wu Chan shouted angrily.
"Hello, senior brother." Wu Xin raised his eyebrows slightly, and quickly glanced at the scene. He caught a glimpse of Xiao Se and Lei Wujie standing in the corner. He smiled slightly, flew to their side, and grabbed one person's shoulder with one hand. "These two seem to be good people. I want to go somewhere. I wonder if the two donors are willing to accompany me."
"Wha...where?" Lei Wujie had not yet reacted to this turn of events.
"I don't want to." Xiao Se answered simply and coldly.
The white-haired man and the purple-clothed man had already stepped into the room again. They smiled unintentionally and said, "What you say is not what you mean." After saying that, he grabbed one with one hand, flew up, kicked open the window, and fell down.
